review_procedures.text: You may file an internal appeal within 180 days after you receive this notice. We will decide a pre-service appeal within 30 days after we receive it.

appeal_and_external_review.text: To start an appeal, write to Utilization Review Appeals, PO Box 0000, Albany, NY 12200. If we uphold this denial, you may ask for an external appeal by an independent reviewer.
